snippet.title: BROKEN SIGNAL: TRAILER - Hectic FPS Roguelike
snippet.description:
This game is still in development!  Feedback and suggestions welcome.  :)
==========​​
BROKEN SIGNAL! Super fast first person action game, jetpacking up towers to break the signal!
- Jetpack & Overclock your way up the radio tower and Break the Signal!
- Unlock 3 difficulty levels, with increasing tower height to overcome.​
- Super explosive, super fast paced, super hard.
- ​​See if you can beat all 3 modes!

==========​​
​Game Developed by Murray Lorden  @muzboz​​

Voices by Brendan Barnett  @Human_Brendan​
Music by My name is Gus  https://soundcloud.com/mynameisgus/
Game Logo by Tom Garden  @TomGarden45​
==========​​
Dev notes: 
- BROKEN SIGNAL is my 7DRL (7 Day Roguelike Challenge) entry for 2020!

==========
See the full Dev Diaries Playlist here:
http://bit.ly/BrokenSignalDevPlaylist
